title: Evidence Reference
description: A pointer to a captured artifact that grounds a discovery claim. This is the shared leaf that every other discovery artifact references by plain string id. Domain-neutral: no source or target technology is named in this schema.

$schema.description: Scheme-less relative path from the instance file to its schema file.

schema_version.description: Instance schema version. Major component pinned to the v1 directory; minor and patch are free.

kind.description: The generic category of the captured artifact.

location.description: A path or URI expressed in the consumer repository's own terms.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the evidence shows.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm label, for example sha256.

content_hash.description: Optional integrity digest of the referenced artifact.

tool.description: Optional label for the tool that produced the evidence.

identifier.description: Shared identifier grammar. Lowercase alphanumeric start; dots, underscores, and hyphens permitted.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp enforced by regex because the validator runs without a FormatChecker.

metadata.title: Free-form consumer metadata
metadata.description: Sanctioned extension point. Additional properties are permitted here only.
